title: I literally couldn't stop laughing
author: RainingHellfire
selftext: I've been working on a small wrestling game demo over the last couple weeks, asked my agent to clean up the abs on a sprite image that I had separated the arm off of and just filled in with blocks. The penciled in abs, on the returned image, just killed me

comments.author: No-Trouble-9138
comments.body: I tell it to "regenerate" the image with the changes, mostly works with GPT

comments.author: Ink_code
comments.body: Idk those abs look very detailed i can't imagine the amount of iterations the agent had to go through to make such perfect abs.
